title: Phase 17: Post status filter (All / Draft / Published)
body: Add filter buttons to the dashboard so users can view All posts, only Drafts (🌱), or only Published (📰) posts. Add StatusFilter enum and state to dashboard.rs, extend display_entries filtering, add a 'Filter:' button group to the filter-sort-bar, add matching CSS, and reset filter on directory navigation. See PLANNING.md Phase 17.
